tested: Monitor run_monitored writes no RUNNING receipt. Popen precedes exclusive launch sidecar, and final receipt follows proc.wait().
Final statuses are FINISHED, STOPPED_WALL_CAP, STOPPED_RSS_CAP, STOPPED_OUTPUT_CAP or CHILD_FAILED. REFUSED returns without writing any receipt.
verify_receipt checks selfhash/schema/optional SHA pins/result bytes; it does not establish exact spec/driver paths, sidecar association, runtime identity, liveness or classification.
finding: Previous prototype selected extra validation solely from the declared origin marker. New selector also checks WAVE call-directory location and presence of external_admission, so deleting or changing the marker cannot select the ordinary path. This is defense hardening; no successful production admission bypass was demonstrated.
next: Observer must not infer terminal failure from missing receipt/sidecar: creation happens after Popen and REFUSED has no receipt. Root registration reserves call while pending. Before terminal fallback validate exact launch/receipt pins, command/caps/child_pid/start association and status/exit/stop consistency. Keep unknown/missing/malformed state HOLD or refusal, never local duplicate. Do not treat verify_receipt alone as complete authentication. No actual monitor run or process query performed.
